notes.title: Waiting for friends
notes.science: Some creatures join only when enough of their friends already have. Each one has a threshold, and one new dancer can tip the next.
notes.limits: Each creature here has one fixed threshold that never changes.
notes.counter: Some people join to follow strangers or a crowd, not friends.
notes.question: How many friends would it take for you to dance?

sources.label: Threshold Models of Collective Behavior, Granovetter, 1978
The Wisdom and/or Madness of Crowds, Nicky Case

notes.title: Across the brook
notes.science: A dance spreads along friendships, wherever the friends stand. Wide bridges, where several ties overlap, carry it best.
notes.limits: The bridge here only lets creatures cross. The dance follows ties, not paths.
notes.counter: Some say being near matters more than being friends.
notes.question: Who was Bell waiting for?

sources.label: The Spread of Behavior in an Online Social Network Experiment, Centola, 2010
The Wisdom and/or Madness of Crowds, Nicky Case

bell: I will dance when my friends dance. Not before. I am not brave alone, and I know it.
